The '''Prototype Rk-4 Sentinel''' was the designation of a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], when it was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Prototype Rk-4 Sentinel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Corellia. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />
